name: JW Marriott Houston by The Galleria
positioning: Uptown Houston hotel across from the Galleria mall, with a rooftop pool overlooking the city, private poolside cabanas and rooms with Galleria and skyline views
best_for: Shoppers who want the Galleria mall just across the street
Travelers who want a rooftop pool with city views
Guests who like to keep up a fitness or yoga routine on the road

facts.text: The hotel sits across from the Galleria mall in Uptown Houston.
The Gerald D. Hines Waterwall Park is within walking distance of the hotel.
Houston's Museum District is a short drive from the hotel.
The hotel is located near the Houston Zoo and Downtown Aquarium.
Rooms have featherbed mattresses, bathrobes and slippers.
Rooms feature curated art and 55-inch TVs.
Luxury suites give additional space and access to the hotel's Concierge Lounge.
The Executive Lounge is a private access floor with complimentary meals, snacks and beverages.
The fitness center is open 24/7 and features a yoga room.
The hotel offers yoga classes that guests can reserve.
Stray Horse, the on-site restaurant and bar, serves breakfast, lunch and dinner with a menu rooted in the bold tastes of the local area.
JW Market is a lobby-level cafe serving Illy coffee and grab-and-go options.

highlights.text: The hotel has a heated rooftop pool overlooking the city.
Guests can reserve one of two private poolside cabanas with poolside Wi-Fi, cold water bottles and a fruit platter.
Many rooms have views of The Galleria and the Houston skyline.
The hotel hosts a Moonlit Sound Bath with crystal singing bowls on the pool deck.
Greens and herbs grown on-site are added to dishes and cocktails.

considerations.text: Pets are not allowed at the hotel.
The hotel is a smoke-free property.
WhataHotel notes that the busy shopping district location comes with heavy traffic.
